architecture.title: Frontend Layer
items: Angular feature-first architecture
Lazy-loaded route modules
Strong TypeScript typing across all layers
Facade/service-store pattern with RxJS
No direct database access from components
All data accessed via callable functions

architecture.title: Backend Layer
items: Firebase Cloud Functions (onCall + onRequest)
Google Cloud Scheduler for daily ingestion jobs
Secret Manager for API key storage
Strict IAM control over all credentials
Backend-only exchange integrations
Custom connectors for unsupported providers

architecture.title: Data Layer
items: Firestore structured per project
Daily trade files stored per project
Deterministic dedupe strategy
Canonical daily record storage
Masked metadata only in client-visible documents

security: Firebase Authentication with custom claims for role assignment
Whitelist document as source of truth for access
Users assigned to projects by owner/admin
Frontend route guards for UX acceleration
Backend authorization enforced on every function call
No secrets ever exposed to frontend
API keys stored in Secret Manager, masked references in Firestore only

deepDive.title: Real-Time Data Strategy
items: All exchange API calls executed server-side
Data written to Firestore only after validation
Frontend subscribed via controlled observable streams
Debounce/throttle to prevent UI jitter
Separation between live ingestion and display state
Avoided snapshot thrashing via selective listeners

deepDive.title: Role-Based Access Model
items: Multi-project access assignment
Owner/Admin define allowed projects per user
Access determined by whitelist document
Claims used for UX acceleration, not as sole authority
Server enforces project-level scoping on every call
Disabled users blocked server-side immediately

deepDive.title: Data Ingestion Pipeline
items: Daily scheduler job triggers ingestion per project
Fetches thousands of trade records per provider
Normalizes records into canonical format
Deduplicates using stable composite keys (timestamp + txId)
Stores per-day trade files with deterministic ordering
Maintains audit-friendly storage structure

challenges.solution: Solved via RxJS staging + shareReplay caching
Implemented explicit loop handling with cursor tracking
Stable composite dedupe keys across all providers
Strict project-scoped queries enforced at backend
Full backend mediation — zero client exposure

improvements: Versioned data contracts with schema validation at boundaries
Centralized authorization helper for all callable functions
Structured observability metrics and anomaly detection
Rate limiting + retry strategies with jitter
